svg.title: Callback timeline
svg.desc: A timeline from 0.6 s to 2.6 s after the node was made, in two panels. In each, the top row shows each plan as a bar and the bottom row each safety check as a tick. Tag 1, single-threaded: plans run from 1.00 to 1.52 s and from 2.00 to 2.50 s; no check runs during a plan, and the longest time between two checks is 0.62 s. Tag 2, multi-threaded, each timer in its own callback group: plans run from 1.00 to 1.50 s and from 2.00 to 2.50 s; the ticks go on during each plan, and the longest time between two checks is 0.10 s.

path.aria-label: time since the node was made (s)
